question: Where’s the closest restaurant along the path to Residence Inn San Diego Downtown/Bayfront, San Diego, CA starting at Mission Hills Church Park, San Marcos, CA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Mission Hills Church Park%' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%San Marcos%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Residence Inn San Diego Downtown/Bayfront%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Diego%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p, start_point AS s, end_point AS e WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' -- Filter restaurants to be within the bounding box of the start and end points -- This approximates "along the path" by ensuring they are geographically between/around the two points AND ST_Within(p.geometry::geography, ST_Envelope(ST_Collect(s.geometry, e.geometry))::geography) -- Order by distance to the destination (Residence Inn) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, e.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
